science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Hector adjusts his grip on the primary grounding mast, leaning into the ozone gale as the twin suns pull a furious four-tesla shear across the ferrofluid sea. 'Jane's differential equation says the upper capacitor bank arcs in ninety seconds, but I only need forty-five to clip the shunt cable!' he shouts over the howling wind, grinning at the chaotic Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear unfolding below. He successfully stabilizes the circuit and confidently tosses the insulated baton down to Kaio, who secures it firmly by the lower induction coil.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Stabilize the primary grounding mast against the Kp-8 magnetic shear.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Calibrate the magnetohydrodynamic grounding shunt for the Stormbreaker.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Prove terrestrial metallurgy can hybridize with sympathetic exoplanet core-ores.

active_location.macro_silhouette: A churning expanse of liquid iron rolls violently beneath the Stormbreaker Spire, whipping metallic spray into the heavy, storm-laden sky. Jagged arcs of Saint Elmo's fire dance across the crests of the black waves. The raw magnetic force of the twin suns contorts the sea into massive, gravity-defying spires.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Flashes of blinding blue corona arcing over churning, obsidian-black ferrofluid waves.
sensory_palette.sound: The deafening crackle of live voltage telemetry snapping over a howling ozone gale.
sensory_palette.smell: The sharp, metallic tang of ionized ozone mixed with the scent of overheating copper.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: The freezing, sleet-filled squall slicing against skin flushed hot by radiant electrical heat.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A bitter copper tang lingering on the tongue from the charged atmosphere.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A surging wall of magnetized liquid iron threatening to overwhelm the lower catwalk.
A raw, crackling geode of captured lightning embedded in the shoreline rock.
A localized polarity inversion creating a vortex that swallows unsecured equipment.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To relentlessly reorganize matter according to the chaotic fluctuations of the twin suns' magnetic fields.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating massive, unpredictable Kelvin-Helmholtz shear waves that physically tear at unshielded structures.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: A sudden four-tesla shear spike that threatens to snap the main induction crucible's tether.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The magnetic shear will achieve critical resonance, causing a chain-reaction structural failure across the entire First Forge.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Hector must physically clip the shunt cable before the upper capacitor bank arcs and overloads the system.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The First Forge needs a stable, zero-fatigue alloy structure to withstand the planet's relentless magnetic storms.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The Enclave's survival depends on mastering the hybrid metallurgy of terrestrial science and exoplanet anomalies.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: The magnetic shear tears the shunt cable loose, fusing the induction crucible and sending a lethal arc-flash across the catwalk.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector misreads the tensile strain; his adjustment accelerates the capacitor arc, destroying the module and injuring Kaio.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The cable is secured, but the effort causes a micro-fissure in the bronze casting, requiring immediate, dangerous field repairs.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: The shunt is perfectly calibrated. The circuit stabilizes, safely grounding the megajoule discharge.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Not only is the circuit stabilized, but the specific frequency of the shear reveals a new resonant property of the local bismuth-bronze alloy.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector successfully stabilizes the circuit and confidently tosses the insulated baton down to Kaio, who secures it firmly by the lower induction coil.
